sections.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Deploys Agent Teams Across All Knowledge Work
sections.lead: Anthropic's new flagship model ships with 1M token context and parallel agent team capability.

sections.title: GLM-5 Achieves Frontier Performance Without US GPUs

sections.title: OpenAI Frontier Treats AI as a Colleague to Hire, Onboard, and Evaluate
sections.lead: OpenAI unveiled Frontier, an end-to-end enterprise platform for operating AI "colleagues" — not just AI models.

sections.title: Snowflake-OpenAI $200M Partnership: Run Agents Where Your Data Lives
sections.lead: Snowflake and OpenAI signed a multi-year $200M partnership to natively integrate GPT-5.2 into the Snowflake platform.

sections.title: Big Tech's $650B 2026 CapEx Makes AI Infrastructure a National-Scale Utility
sections.lead: The combined 2026 AI infrastructure investment of Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft hit an all-time record.

sections.title: Google Secures Emerging Market Foothold with $15B India AI Investment
sections.lead: At India's AI Impact Summit, Google announced $15 billion in investment and a submarine cable initiative.

sections.title: ChatGPT Adds Ads, Sharpening the Value of Paid Subscriptions
sections.lead: OpenAI began testing ads in the ChatGPT Free and Go ($8/month) tiers in the US.

sections.title: Self-Validating AI Becomes Autonomous Worker in Manufacturing
sections.lead: As of February 2026, self-validating AI — which verifies and corrects its own results at each step — is emerging as a major trend in manufacturing and industrial domains.

sections.title: OpenClaw and Moltbook Confirm Agents Amplify Dangerous Instructions Between Each Other
sections.lead: An arXiv study reported patterns of dangerous instruction amplification in the Moltbook environment, where agents interact Reddit-style.

sections.title: Sovereign AI, Agent SEO, and English as a Programming Language — Three Structural Trends
sections.lead: February 2026 confirms three simultaneous structural trends: national AI sovereignty competition, agent visibility optimization, and natural-language-driven development.
